cause: The V1 extractor coupled grid acceptance to unique close OCR text even though its authorized purpose is source-grid derivation for a deliberately sparse glyph.
successorPrevention: Apply one generic rule to every fresh case: all close image-only hypotheses must have one exact grid tuple; OCR-string disagreement cannot select or reject that grid. Select the highest image score only after exact grid consensus, and continue to hold any case with multiple close grids.
